chain.speaker: Ivan
chain.gist: Ivan proposes cutting every department's budget by 8 percent across the board.
chain.option: an across-the-board 8 percent cut to every department's budget

chain.speaker: Ivan
chain.gist: Ivan argues that it is simple and seen as fair, can be in the budget file by the 20th, and lets each department head choose where to cut.
chain.option: an across-the-board 8 percent cut to every department's budget

chain.speaker: Wei
chain.gist: Wei reports that 62 percent of the budget is committed under multi-year contracts, so an 8 percent cut of the total is really about 21 percent of the remaining uncommitted lines.
chain.option: an across-the-board 8 percent cut to every department's budget

chain.speaker: Yuki
chain.gist: Yuki proposes targeted cuts instead, aimed at travel, contractors and events on the uncommitted lines.
chain.option: targeted cuts to travel, contractors and events on the uncommitted lines, adding up to the same 8 percent

chain.speaker: Yuki
chain.gist: Yuki argues that concentrated cuts protect hiring and tooling, since spreading 21 percent over every uncommitted line would hit the product tooling renewals due in the second quarter.
chain.option: targeted cuts to travel, contractors and events on the uncommitted lines, adding up to the same 8 percent

chain.speaker: Aisha
chain.gist: Aisha picks the targeted cuts to travel, contractors and events.
